annotations.title: 6-10 and 8-14 day temperature & precipitation outlook (NOAA CPC)

description: 6-10 and 8-14 day temperature & precipitation outlook (NOAA CPC) — Two-week outlook for any US point from the NOAA Climate Prediction Center: for days 6-10 and days 8-14, whether temperature and precipitation lean ABOVE NORMAL / NEAR NORMAL / BELOW NORMAL / EQUAL CHANCES, the probability, the valid date range, and a plain-English summary (e.g. warmer than normal likely, 70%). Params: lat, lon (decimal degrees; US incl. Alaska and Hawaii). For energy, retail, agriculture and event planning beyond the 7-day forecast. Public-domain US government data. JSON. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_extended_outlook
